The majority of the Steam Deck changes are increases to text size. There was a lot of quite small text around the UI and HUD that has been moved about and enlarged. Next Update...
The next update will be the big one in terms of feedback. If all goes well it should have the following:

Big friendly ship in final sector boss fights will hyperdrive jump away rather than get destroyed.

Level difference modifiers will be reduced, so fighting a few levels higher wont be so hard and fighting a few levels below wont be a cake walk.

All damage is going to be scaled back a bit, but to balance this consumable will be nerfed as well. This should go some way to stop the game being so punishing when you mess up in later sectors.

Storage space is going to be increased in the Assembler, vastly.

Brightness sliders are going to be added for ship parts so you can make darker ships if you want.

notes.title: Post Launch Patch (v0.5.65)
notes.notes:
Well, this is my first ever live update so this is a bit terrifying. The launch has gone fantastically, far better than I could have hoped, so thank you to everyone who took the plunge and joined us for Early Access.

I spent the night before launch reading negative reviews of some of my favourite games, trying to prepare myself for the fact that some people will not like your game no matter how good it is... but I never could have anticipated that I'd get this much positive feedback.

So again, thank you to everyone for your support, feedback and bug reports. I hope I've managed to address some of it in the update below, if not, it'll almost certainly be coming soon.


Rescues + Consumables
Depending on your choice of weapons, Rescue Encounters can be pretty easy or impossible. I've been trying to balance them for over a year. This latest change should help a bit more with that. Whenever you use a consumable on your ship, whether it's a capsule, hull nanobots or a shield battery, it will now also apply the same effect to the friendly rescue ship.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42825867/c27db9a9021c584af4af3a216bf0705083b601e4.png"]

This friendly consumable sharing now also applies to allies in warzone encounters and any ships you summon with beacon weapons.


Sector Regeneration
It's come to my attention that some players didn't realize you can regenerate your sector. As you're loading in, there is an option to change your seed or just regenerate your existing sector. This will reset all the encounters to an incomplete state so you can do them again, useful if you want to farm bosses or elites for certain types of weapons. Everything about your ship stays the same (level, upgrades, items, mission progress, achievements, etc). It's just the sector that refreshes. You also keep any Waypoint encounters you've unlocked so you don't have to start from the very beginning each time.

I've added a couple of prompts in game, one below the sector generation once you've completed 20% or more. Another below completed encounter rewards in the navigation panel.


Bug Fixes
Nothing else was super exciting, mostly bug fixes. I've reduced Black Market prices by 33% so that should help save you a few credits. Enemy hit boxes have been moved about and mostly expanded to make things a little easier to hit.



Oh, and your control bindings will reset, as I've moved where they are saved as some players had errors saving them to the computer's registry.



As always full notes, are below, in-game and on our Discord. Thanks again for playing, more to come in the following days.


Patch Notes

• Global achievements can now be earned regardless of difficulty settings.


Balance Changes
• Reduced price of black market items by 33%.

Quality of Life / Accessibility

notes.title: Version Regression (v0.3.9)
notes.notes:
So, the version numbers were getting ahead of themselves. With Early Access fast approaching being at 0.9 made it look like a full release was a short time away but it's certainly not.

While the game will be fully playable at launch. There are still a ton of things I want to add, not least of which is mod support and maybe even multiplayer. So I've rolled the version back to 0.3.9.

When Sector 3 is done we'll hit 0.4.0 and from there, every big milestone will bump the version closer to 1.0.0. This changes nothing about my plans it just reflects them more clearly.


Fleet Improvements
You'll no longer find the Black Market in the Mothership, this didn't make a lot of sense anyway. It'll now be tagging along in a separate vessel as I'm sure Admiral Gideon would not approve.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42825867/7844966771bf4ac88a95df2ba111a0caa91d0887.png"]
The Assembler now also deploys an Identification Web when it arrives. Simply fly near this structure and it'll scan every item in your cargo. It's sadly far less chatty than Deckard Cain was though.

Everything else for this update is just quality of life and small fixes. More content coming in the next update!

notes.title: Hotfix (v0.9.13-1)
notes.notes:
Another small hotfix today to fix some bugs and issues.

What's with all these updates?
I'm glad you asked! We're currently doing some influencer outreach and a Keymailer campaign. This means some streamers are starting to play the game.

I should probably mention that I hate this. Watching people play the game always makes me nervous, even when they're clearly having a good time. It's a necessary evil though. Sometimes they notice issues, sometimes I notice issues, these hotfixes are me trying to fix them as quickly as possible.

Difficulty Locks
Some players jump straight into Hardcore mode, a choice I personally wouldn't make, but to each their own. Then there are the truly insane ones who start on both Hardcore mode and Impossible difficulty. There is no way that’s ever going to be a positive experience.

From now if want to play on Formidable difficulty, you'll need to get a player to level 10 first. Impossible and Custom difficulties are locked until level 20.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42825867/000b030a1f4a32fbb469e9b0e2891efc09bdd69e.png

Camera Motion
There was a complaint on our Steam Community that sometimes the movement would feel like objects were coming towards you instead of you moving towards them. It's one of those that once someone points it out it's hard to unsee.

As such I've added a new dust layer to backgrounds that should make movement a little clearer. Failing this you can enable a movement grid under the Accessibility settings if you still dislike it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42825867/392bd3235cc96f2e6995e19106582f090db81952.png

Global Lighting
If you noticed the game was really dark it's because there was a bug with the global lighting after watching the intro cinematic. This has now been fixed... but I kind of liked it, so global lighting has been reduced by 20% to make things a little darker than it used to be.

Enjoy, check our #coverage channel in Discord if you want to watch some of the Streams and reviews!

notes.title: Update 0.8.9 - Story Time
notes.notes:
I've tried hard to make Star Vortex feel like a classic ARPG. Whether I've been successful or not remains to be seen but there is one thing that has been missing is an interesting story-line. In this update I hope to address this.

Story Overhaul
The patch notes may look unimpressive for this version but don't be fooled. Every bit of dialog has been re-written, thousands of words in total. On top of this new dialog and encounters have been added, along with a new character.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42825867/dab3349e16d777673b1809bb6ac277e6bc815c8b.png

A new creature named Echo will now join you during the introduction and tutorial. And then a few more times through Sector 1 (not Sector 2 yet). A mysterious and cryptic entity she will offer guidance and aid but her motives remain a mystery.

Translation - Work In Progress
In the coming days our professional human translation of our store page will fall in to place. We're aiming for English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Simplified Chinese and Spanish. I have also enabled these languages in game so I can start working on and fixing layout issues.

Important!
I'm changing content far too quickly right now to get the game itself translated professionally. It costs about $0.10 USD per word per language and the game currently has over 8,000 words in it. As such the game is using Google Translated content for now, we'll look at options to get it translated when we go in to Early Access.

The next update is aimed at addressing repetitiveness in some of the encounters. New siege encounters will be added where the player assaults alien structures along with dense nebula encounters where visibility is limited. I'll also be doing a full balance pass of Sector 1 and adding a few exploits with excessive kiting of bosses.

Hope you enjoy the new story, more to come!

notes.title: Update 0.8.86 - Improvements from Feedback
notes.notes:
I've recently been running some playtests and this update is pretty much all changes and fixes from the feedback I've received. Mostly quality of life improvements.

Demo Change
As much as I loved the idea of having a Free Edition that players can play it's beginning to hinder our marketing efforts having it out before release. It's an idea I hope to re-visit after we go in to Early Access but for now the demo is back to being a restricted experience of the first Sector.

If you were enjoying playing beyond that and would like to continue to do so jump on our Discord and check the #faq channel for information on how to become a tester!

Discord: https://discord.gg/ePgg7qgs4b

Release Date Change
The release date has been pushed back to Q2 2025 as a result of some of the recent playtests. I want to make sure I have the strongest release possible and I'm going to use these extra months to improve the storyline and content in Sector 2 and 3. Hopefully I'll also be able to cram in some extra features.

Encounter Variety
Warzone encounters felt fun when I made them, waves of friendly and enemy forces colliding leads to some enjoyable chaos. They soon get old when you realise that Intercept and Elite encounters are just warzones with a different final waves though. No longer!

Intercept encounters no longer have waves, the transports will be there at the beginning and to complete the encounter you must destroy them in under 30 seconds before they escape. Kind of the opposite of a Rescue encounter.

Elite encounters no longer have waves either, and you have 60 seconds to destroy the initial enemies before the elite arrives... ready or not.

In addition to this I will add Siege encounters soon, which will be attacks on stationary enemy star bases. These will take the place of the final elites for each faction and be scattered around Skeran and Phantom space.

Narrative Overhaul
While I may have captured the gameplay of old school ARPGs like Diablo it is becoming apparent that I've fallen short with the story-line. Look out in the upcoming updates for some new characters, backstory and strange encounters that hint at some things to come.

Mailing List
We now have a mailing list you can join! I don't always trust social media to show me things I actually want to see, so to be sure not to miss out on our news you can signup here.

https://mailchi.mp/huntedcow/uxgtk0iu7x

Enjoy, full patch notes can be found below!

notes.title: Update 0.7.03 - Balance
notes.notes:
This update is a collection of changes to game balance across all the current content.

Enemy Scaling
Due to players getting more upgrades, more rare weapons and better synergy at higher levels, the linear increase in difficulty was insufficient. Especially in regard to damage as players get more armor, resistances, etc. The base scaling applied to enemies is shown below, it may need to be adjusted as we reach higher and higher levels of content, but for now I believe it provides an adequate challenge for the content we have.


 Level 1  = 104% Damage - 140% Hull / Shield
 Level 5  = 138% Damage - 149% Hull / Shield
 Level 10 = 200% Damage - 167% Hull / Shield
 Level 15 = 277% Damage - 193% Hull / Shield
 Level 20 = 365% Damage - 224% Hull / Shield
 Level 25 = 462% Damage - 260% Hull / Shield
 Level 30 = 567% Damage - 301% Hull / Shield


Bonuses to hull for higher ship classes have been reduced, and damage vs lower level enemies has been increased in both directions. In addition, encounters with different / rare rewards now modify damage more than hull and shields as this feels nicer.

This is a full balance pass, so there are obviously a host of additional more specific changes based on player feedback. All the special weapons should now feel more viable, along with drones and auto stinger launchers. Every elite and boss has been individually tuned to what we think feels right.

As always, weapon changes aren't retroactive so I'd recommend a new play through to try out the changes in full. Enjoy!

Free Lasers
Players will no longer be required to unlock Lasers with an upgrade. This brings the Mechanic and Engineer trees nicely in line. In addition, Mechanics get a +25% rate of fire to projectiles, which is essentially just more damage so to balance this Engineers now get a second +25% damage to lasers upgrade at the bottom of the tree. Some of the starting ships can now start with lasers as well which feels nicer.

Free Thrusters
Unlocking thrusters felt a bit dumb and it was requested during Next Fest that we have some upgrades that are more broad in their scope. Thus, both thruster unlocks have been replaced with generic improvements to damage and critical hit chance.

Upgrades Reset
Due to the above all upgrades in save games will be reset on your next load. It's also a lot cheaper to reset them for credits now.

Hull Regen Balance
Balancing hull regen was impossible, it was always too much at low levels and too little at high levels. All hull regen from upgrades and equipment is now given as a percentage of maximum hull. This has been retroactively applied to Bio Network passives.

Global Loot Table
Enemies have always dropped the weapons they use themselves, but now 20% of the time they'll drop random weapons instead. When pulling from the global loot table they're also 4x more likely to drop things you're currently using. This table is also used for the black market (which is also now twice as likely to give you rares) and encounter rewards.

Requested Features
Click the star on some equipment in your cargo to mark it as a favourite and it'll not be sold by the quick sell options at the Mothership. You can also check the Auto Repair checkbox while you're there to just repair every time you dock.

This is the first of two updates based purely on feedback I have received during Next Fest. If you've made any suggestions, you'll hopefully see them addressed here.

Item / Hull / Shield Scaling
Despite our recent balance changes, some feedback indicated that enemies were still too tough. What was actually happening was that weapons were becoming ineffective far too quickly due to the +10% hull / shield per level enemies received.

As such, we've reduced this to +2% hull / shield for the player and enemies. This also applies to weapon damage which used to be +10% and is now also +2%. This is a huge change but it should result in weapons being useful five times longer than they used to be as you level up. In order to allow for easier testing, this change HAS been applied retroactively, so all your old weapons and ships should be updated.

Damage Scaling
As a side effect of this change, you could now fight much higher-level enemies. To counter this a little, I've re-added in the damage, debuff, and experience scaling from the level difference detailed below.

Grey Enemies (5 or more below)
20% damage, 0% chance to debuff, and 0% experience.

Green Enemies (3 to 4 below)
50% damage, 50% less chance to debuff, and 50% experience.

Yellow Enemies (2 below to 2 higher)
Normal values for everything.

Orange (3 to 4 higher)
150% damage, normal chance to debuff, and 150% experience.

Red (5 or more higher)
200% damage, double chance to debuff, and 200% experience.

Experience Gain
As the above changes will impact the enemies you can fight and come with some bonuses to experience for fighting higher-level enemies, I'm reluctant to touch the experience equation just yet. I'll review the curve of experience required in a future update once this one has had time to be tested.

Ship Part Limits
Five parts were kind of rubbish for the Frigate design, so you now get 10. And additional parts for bigger ships.

Hitboxes
All smaller enemy ships use a circle as their hitbox; the size of this circle has been doubled. This should make small enemies easier to hit.

AI Changes
I recently removed all friendly fire as it didn't make much sense to keep as a mechanic; all it did was result in enemies accidentally killing each other. However, a side effect of this was that enemies would now all shoot you at once, as they could shoot through their friends without conciquince.

This vastly increased damage received when a large group of enemies attack you at once. As such, I've now changed the AI so they try to avoid shooting through friendly targets. This should limit the overwhelming damage when attacked by large groups.

 The control tutorial now includes pictures and brief explanations.
 Progress through individual tutorial steps is now shown.
 Dodge effect now leaves after images of the dodging ship, like temporal drive.
 Double tape to dodge is now ignored if dodge control has a binding.
 Dodge-related control binding displays are now easier to understand.
 Turret mode now saves to the player and persists between encounters/sessions.
 Reworded 'return to mothership' instruction to 'return to fleet' for clarity.
 Removed the quick jump option from navigation as more confusing than helpful.
 Added an extra yellow circle around the current encounter in navigation to make it easier to see.
 Added a new accessibility setting called heading assist to easily see your ship's heading.
 Line assist and the new heading assist will match your setting for cursor color.
 Mission display in HUD now displays control binding and uncollected mission alerts.
 Overhauled all control bindings for ship design, now displaying them in relevant positions.

Bug Fixes

 Fixed Sprite ships in the fleet not healing the player when they've taken damage.
 Respawn overlay should now display regardless of the pause status of the game.
 Fixed rebound launchers not returning to the parent ship and getting stuck in orbit.
 Players can no longer discard the tutorial equipment.
 Turrets can once again be grappled, still not drones though.
 Fixed error where exiting game then going to ship design in sandbox tried to spawn dialog.
 Fixed large shortcut binding display in the equipment panel.
 Fixed large shortcut binding display on consumables.
 Hitting cancel/escape when the file browser is open now closes the file browser.
 Fixed tooltips being misplaced due to UI scale changes.
 Fixed incorrect display of left / right when referring to controller shoulder buttons.
 Fixed an issue where opening and closing the core panel quickly would lock up the game.
 The first Wasp to spawn from Matriach is no longer invisible.
 The radial display now hides itself when the ship is hyperjumping in / out.

notes.title: Update 0.4.25
notes.notes:

A few bug fixes and you can now use custom avatars from your computer when playing the game!

 Players can no longer hyperjump when partially through a displacement animation.
 Fixed frame rate drop and performance issues that occurred after pausing the game.
 Grapples can no longer be attached to drones.
 Template folders in ship design hidden for factions you have not unlocked yet.
 Fixed incorrect shortcut binding displays on some smaller buttons.
 Fixed incorrect key on virtual keyboard.
 No longer using uppercase on translated strings to avoid errors in future languages.
 Fleet ships will no longer target the inactive ship wrecks in the tutorial.

notes.title: Update 0.4.2
notes.notes:
Some big balance changes to heat and hopefully made it clearer to see overheating and understand how it works.

New Features / Content
⦁ Overheated is now a status effect and functions as such.
⦁ Added visual effect on ships when overheated.

Balance Changes
⦁ Ship heat capacity is now multiplied by number of equipped primary weapons.
⦁ Frigates now get 25 heat capacity per primary weapon.
⦁ Destroyers now get 50 heat capacity per primary weapon.
⦁ Cruisers now get 75 heat capacity per primary weapon.
⦁ Battleships now get 100 heat capacity per primary weapon.
⦁ Reduced turn speed of all ships by a further 25.
⦁ Slightly adjusted sector generation to add a few level 3 encounters early on.
⦁ Nightfall is now level 9 instead of level 8.
⦁ Reduced Railgun heat from 5 to 3.
⦁ Reduced Magma Gun heat from 5 to 4.
⦁ Reduced Freeze Gun heat from 7.5 to 4.
⦁ Reduced Acid Gun heat from 6 to 5.
⦁ Reduced Inferno Cannon heat from 6 to 5.
⦁ Reduced Freeze Ray heat from 10 to 8.
⦁ Reduced Skeran Laser heat from 10 to 8.
⦁ Increased Cryo Gun heat from 4 to 5.
⦁ Increased Flamethrower heat from 4 to 5.
⦁ Increased Plasmathrower heat from 4 to 5.
⦁ Increased Plasma Blaster heat from 5 to 6.
⦁ Increased Scattergun heat from 5 to 6.
⦁ Increased Caustic Laser heat from 5 to 8.
⦁ Increased Heat Ray heat from 5 to 8.

Quality of Life / Accessibility
⦁ Combined some controller shortcuts and added them to more buttons.
⦁ Added message on HUD below player bar when you have unspent upgrade points.

Bug Fixes
⦁ Fixed issue where hitting virtual keyboard shortcuts would trigger shortcuts on other UI below.
⦁ Fixed error when switching between ship templates in ship design.
⦁ Required level displayed before scanning items is now accurate with modifiers included.

notes.title: Update 0.4.1
notes.notes:
Another big update, this one contains lots of requested features, QoL improvements and bugs that you guys have been reporting on our Discord!

New Features / Content

 Ship designs can now be used even if they have more slots than you have unlocked through upgrades.
 Equipment panel now shows 'slot not unlocked' for slots on a ship you cannot use yet.
 Added the ability to reset slot selection on your ship for a cost in credits.


Balance Changes

 Upgrades and slots can only be reset when you're at the mothership.
 Dodge cooldown increased from 0.25s to 1.0s.
 Mines now have less linear drag so they spread out further when deployed.


Quality of Life / Accessibility

 Players can now sell multiple items quickly using the new options at the bottom of the mothership panel.
 Sell confirmation message now includes how many credits you'll get.
 Pressing the quick jump binding at the mothership will jump you back to where you came from.
 Added quick jump location and details to navigation panel.
 Added new shortcut binding for controllers to quick jump on navigation panel.
 Smoothed out dodge dampening a bit at the end of dodge movements.
 Dodge cooldown is now displayed above ship bar on HUD.
 Added developer console button to pause menu, not available in demo.
 Equipment view to right side of mothership panel now includes locked slots.
 Grapple guns can now attach to mine projectiles.
 Hyperdrive jumping in and out of encounters no longer hides the HUD.
 Hyperdrive jump can now be cancelled while in countdown phase.


Bug Fixes

 Game is now playabale on ultra-wide resolutions, although it looks a bit stretched on very wide splays.
 Reset to default no longer maxes our sandbox sector size slider.
 Fixed bug where grapple guns were not turning to aim like primary / secondary weapons.
 Fixed error from InputController when loading bindings in the menu.
 Fixed error when trying to clone Orchid in elite encounters.
 Fixed error when status effect destroys ship in the middle of hyperjumping out.
 Radar now shows correct enemy count when enemies attack the fleet.
 Quitting during the hand holding part of the tutroial will no longer save your game.
 Fixed bug where binding dodge to a specific key would not cap max velocity.
 Collecting a mission now correctly auto-tracks the next mission the player has.
 Collecting a mission no longer breaks controller navigation at the top of the panel.
 Slot display in upgrade panel now updates correctly when slot is unlocked via upgrade.
 Fixed some instances when swapping passive equipment would not work.
 Developer complete path tool will now complete mission requirements as well.
 Developer tools in navigation will no longer show up until player docks with mothership at Novus Prime.

notes.title: UPDATE 0.4.0
notes.notes:
VERSION 0.4.0

Mouse / Keyboard Changes

 Added optional 'turret mode' which allows you to aim weapons independently when enabled.
 Key binding added to toggle turret mode, defauled to Z.
 Keys for strafing now change to turning when in turret mode.
 Reverse is now bound to S and stabilize is moved to X by default.


Controller Changes

 Remapped all controls, firing is now on shoulder buttons, right stick can be used to aim weapons, etc.
 Added an aim assistance cursor when using a controller to play.
 Optional control binding added for reverse, not set by default on controller.


New Features / Content

 Double tap strafe (in strafe mode when using mouse / keyboard) to dodge in that direction.
 Added setting to disable double tap strafe to dodge.
 Optional control binding added for dodge left and right, not set by default.
 Thrusters now have a reverse stat which is slower than other directions.
 Enabled cursor color option in accessibility on steam deck for controller aim assist.
 Added new control binding prompts to the tutorial.
 Custom control bindings have been reset due to new control mechanics.


Balance Changes

 Removed armor and resistance from difficulty selection as they ruin gameplay.
 Rebalanced values for each difficulty to account for removal changes.
 Improved strafe speed on all thrusters to match acceleration and make it more useful.
 Players now gain +1 cargo space every time they level-up.
 Reduced Frigate turn speed to 200 from 300.
 Reduced Destroyer turn speed to 175 from 275.
 Reduced Cruiser aim speed to 125 from 175.
 Reduced Cruiser turn speed to 150 from 250.
 Reduced Battleship aim speed to 150 from 175.
 Reduced Battleship turn speed to 125 from 200.
 Reduced Boss aim speed to 150 from 200.
 Reduced Boss turn speed to 125 from 200.


Quality of Life / Accessibility

 Added play shortcut key for controllers to difficulty select and sector generation.


Bug Fixes

 Fixed issues where some controller bindings would display incorrectly on pause menu.
 Rescue ships now hyperjump away when encounter is complete.
 Weapon tags no longer animate with scan line when scanning items.
 Upgrade tooltips now correctly explain why you can't add points to a locked upgrade.
 Rapidly hitting escape in mothership no longer results in the wrong cursor displaying.

notes.title: Update 0.3.9
notes.notes:
The difficulty system has been completely reworked. You can now choose your level of difficulty before you generate your sector. Enemy stats will be increased but so will your item / credit salvage.

New Features / Content

 Removed old difficulty system entirely.
 Added new difficulty system with relaxed, normal, challenging, formidable, impossible and custom options.
 Added difficulty information to core panel navigation tab.
 Added difficulty icon to HUD radar.
 Added difficulty selection to sandbox setup.


Balance Changes

 Only 25% of credits is now dropped on death, not cargo.
 Boosting no longer disables weapons as mechanic was frustrating.
 Average durability loss of 1 point per 5 seconds from a single item when taking hull damage.
 Black market items are now always your ships level (within constraints of sector level range)
 Black market items prices halved.
 Resistance and armor now caps at 80% for all ships.
 Behemoth now correctly has 5x the hull.
 Razor mine launcher no longer drops below level 5.
 Explosive egg launcher no longer drops below level 5.


Quality of Life / Accessibility

 DPS displayed on equipment now includes crit chance and crit damage.
 Sector size slider in sandbox now snaps to nearest 50 value.


Bug Fixes

 Increased shield and hull of mothership and freighters.
 Repair cost of items now rounds up to nearest whole number.
 Typing non-numeric characters in discard / sell quantity no longer throws exceptions.
 Fixed issue where some dialog would not animate when playing with a controller.
 Fixed error when Vipers try to jump in warzone encounters.
 Complete encounters no longer show incorrect enemy count on radar.
 Fixed credit / item salvage showing each others values in equipment panel.

notes.title: Update 0.3.8
notes.notes:
Another update with a host of balance changes in response to people play testing our demo. Please continue giving us feedback on Discord as you test things out!

New Features / Content

 Added version number to bottom right of HUD, setting added to Advanced to disable it.
 Items now permanently track the game version they came from and display it below their image.
 Piercing projectiles will now hit each enemy ship once regardless of size.


Equipment Buffs

 Cryo Gun, Plasmathrower and Flamethrower now have piercing projectiles.
 Torando Launcher missiles now snap to 3x their explosive radius on to enemy targets.
 Doubled angular drag of stalker / javelin missiles increasing their accuracy.
 Increased ROF of inferno cannon by 25%.
 Increased ROF of railgun by 25%.
 Point defense lasers now target closest valid target.
 Increased short / long range PDL damage by 25%.


Equipment Nerfs

 Different items no longer get a flat +25% increase in damage / duration / shield / etc.
 Rare items no longer get a flat +50% increase in damage / duration / shield / etc.
 Reduced scatter gun damage by 50%, velocity by 20% and heat generated increased 25%.
 Reduced plasma blaster damage by 50%.
 Reduced proton torpedo launcher ROF by 50%.
 Reduced javelin launcher ROF by 33%.
 Reduced stalker launcher ROF by 50%.
 Reduced stalker and javelin launcher projectile hull by 50%.
 Reduced caustic laser damage by 20%.
 Reduced freeze ray damage by 20%.
 Reduced heat ray damage by 20%.
 Reduced skeran laser damage by 20%.
 Reduced tesla coil damage by 20%.
 Reduced damage of Hornet Drones by 20%.
 Reduced damage of Roach Drones by 20%.


Quality of Life / Accessibility

 Added new Shortcuts category to assignable controls.
 Buttons in equipment panel can now have shortcut buttons assigned to them.
 Hyperjump button in navigation can now have a shortcut button assigned to it.
 Global modifiers button in equipment can now have a shortcut button assigned to it.
 Sandbox play button can now have a shortcut button assigned to it.
 Ship design finished button can now have a shortcut button assigned to it.
 Controller navigation up and down mission panel now makes more logical sense.
 Added controller bindings to backspace, shift and done in virtual keyboard.
 Disabled Steam keyboard in favour of the custom virtual keyboard in game.
 Controller navigation now locks to options when assigning consumables.
 Cargo space value now shows in red if cargo is full.
 Quantity of non-stackable items can no longer be modified for sell / discard.
 Inverted shift keys on virtual keyboard to match normal setup.
 Virtual keyboard when using non-Steam controllers now wraps navigation around edges.
 Renamed god mode status effect to invulnerability to match setting.


Bug Fixes

 Fixed exploit where you could sell more items than you had in a stack.
 Hunter (elite) should now only spawn trap with both you and it inside.
 Edges of cloud layer are no longer visible on higher camera distances.
 Credits no longer display max stack size when given as rewards.
 Custom sandbox ships are no longer invulnerable to damage.
 Sector Keystones no longer drop on death.
 Error handler no longer pops up on Warnings like controller connections.
 Scatter missiles that instantly explode no longer leave orphaned warning circles.
 Warzone waves will no longer exceed maximum waves if enemies are quickly destroyed.
 Hitting cancel / escape in the mission panel will now hide the level up banner.
 Dialog text animation should play for all text again.
 Text input fields no longer revert their value when cancel / escape hit.
ug Fixes
